player_prompt.intro:
Wiri Player {player_id} muNegotiation Game.
Unenge wachiwanika nezvinhu, na chakuitika chako kufungidza kutengeserana zvinhu izvi kuti jumla ya thamani yezvinhu yako ipendeke.
Zvinhu na maadhi anowana kwa sasa zvinhu izvi:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Pa kila turn, unogona kungwerengera na mwana weoponendi na kubatsira offer.
Tengai tokens zidziro zvinotevema kwa ajensi:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Zvinhu zvakabatsirwa -> Zvinhu zvakadzorwa]
  - '[Accept]': Kudzorera offer inotuma.
  - '[Deny]': Kukana offer inotuma (default).
Game ino ina miguu {max_turns} yose.

invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Mutambi {player_id} akaita chipo chokutsinhanisa nenzira isina kururama.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Mutambi {player_id} haana kupa chimwe chipo chitsva chokutsinhanisa.
